data.gender_notes: Borden is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English bor, meaning 'fortified place', and denu, meaning 'valley'. The name Borden can be translated to 'dweller in the fortified place'. The name Borden carries the meaning “Brave, bold” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Borden usually hope their child will grow to embody brave, bold and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Borden total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
